---
title: "Livestock Numbers (1971-2019)"
format: html
---

Exploring New Zealand livestock population data from 1971 to 2019.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
livestock <- read_csv("livestock-numbers-clean-1971-2019.csv")
livestock
```

## Data Overview

```{r}
cat("Animals:", paste(unique(livestock$animal), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Geography types:", paste(unique(livestock$geography_type), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
livestock |>
  filter(geography_type == "New Zealand") |>
  summarise(
    `Min (millions)`  = round(min(count, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6, 2),
    `Max (millions)`  = round(max(count, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6, 2),
    `Mean (millions)` = round(mean(count, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6, 2),
    .by = animal
  ) |>
  arrange(animal)
```

## National Trends Over Time

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
nz <- livestock |>
  filter(
    geography_type == "New Zealand",
    animal != "Total cattle",
    !is.na(count)
  ) |>
  mutate(count_millions = count / 1e6)

ggplot(nz, aes(x = year, y = count_millions, colour = animal)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~animal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "New Zealand Livestock Numbers (1971-2019)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Count (millions)",
    colour = "Animal"
  )
```
